description: This file declares functions, types, and constants related to 'git describe' routines in the libgit2 library, including options for describing commits and formatting describe results.

methods.name: git_describe_init_options
methods.description: Initializes a git_describe_options structure with a specified version.

methods.name: git_describe_init_format_options
methods.description: Initializes a git_describe_format_options structure with a specified version.

methods.name: git_describe_commit
methods.description: Performs a description of a specific commit object.

methods.name: git_describe_workdir
methods.description: Performs a description of the current worktree state.

methods.name: git_describe_format
methods.description: Formats the describe result into a buffer.

methods.name: git_describe_result_free
methods.description: Frees memory allocated for a describe result.
